summary.en: Separate the capture medium from the way a finished picture is delivered.
summary.zh-cn: 把拍摄时的记录介质与成品输出方式分开。

boundary.en: Film, digital capture and instant output can overlap in a hybrid system. Pinhole describes an image-forming opening, not a recording medium.
boundary.zh-cn: 混合系统可以同时数码拍摄与即时胶片输出。针孔描述成像孔口，不是一种记录介质。

en: A film camera records a latent image for chemical development. A digital camera converts an electronic sensor signal into data. These descriptions do not specify how the photographer views the scene. The instax mini Evo combines digital capture with instant-film output, showing why both stages should be recorded.
zh-cn: 胶片相机记录供化学显影使用的潜影，数码相机把电子传感器信号转为数据。这些描述不指定摄影者如何取景。instax mini Evo 把数码拍摄与即时胶片输出结合起来，说明需要同时描述两个阶段。

sources.title: FUJIFILM instax mini Evo Specifications
sources.supports: Digital CMOS capture and output onto instax mini instant film coexist in a hybrid system.
